instability (MM, VGT, see word); hence, confusion, tumult: 1Co.14:33, Jas.3:16; pl. (Bl., §32, 6), Luk.21:9, 2Co.6:5, 12:20 (Polyb., al.; see Cremer, 739).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: When you hear of wars and disturbances, don’t be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won’t come immediately.”
for God is not a God of confusion, but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.
in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings;
For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.
